Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an unsupported, anachronistic inference by equating “Ottoman sultan” with “Turkish (Turkey)” nationality. Britannica confirmed Selim II was an Ottoman sultan but did not state his nationality as Turkish. The Planner prematurely declared the task complete and provided “Turkish (Turkey)” without authoritative citation for that specific nationality, overlooking the historically appropriate designation “Ottoman.”
